biography: Gabriel Robe, born in the vibrant heart of Porto Alegre, Brazil, discovered his passion for speed not on the football field, but watching Ayrton Senna tear through the streets of Monaco. His father, a mechanic with a local karting team, recognized the spark in young Gabriel and gifted him a battered kart on his tenth birthday. The kart was more rust than machine, but it was enough. Robe spent countless hours mastering the local karting circuit, often skipping school to hone his skills. He rose through the ranks quickly, securing several regional championships before transitioning to Formula Renault Brazil. His early career was marked by flashes of brilliance overshadowed by costly errors, a trait that would define his inconsistent performance throughout his professional life. After stints with Mottin Racing and Motortech, Robe found a degree of stability with Wokin Garra Racing, where he currently competes, aiming to finally translate his raw talent into consistent championship contention. While he is considered past the age of drivers that would move to F1, he is still a legend in the Brazilian racing scene.
drivingStyle: Robe is a driver of extremes. When he's 'on,' he's virtually untouchable, displaying a breathtaking blend of aggression and precision. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and daring overtakes, often pushing the limits of adhesion. However, this aggressive style frequently leads to tire degradation and costly mistakes. Under pressure, Robe can become erratic, either pulling off miraculous saves or succumbing to unforced errors. His tire management is considered a weakness, often burning through rubber in the early stages of a race, leaving him vulnerable in the closing laps.

careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian Stock Car Championship in 2018 after a nail-biting final race where he started from the back of the grid and fought his way to victory.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the 2021 Cascavel de Ouro, handing the victory to his arch-rival, Ricardo Vargas.
